backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing user profiles and habit data with access control, including habit creation, completion tracking, and optional volume tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of various frontend source files for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light and dark color schemes and shared styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: Static HTML root file loading the React application entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component setting up QueryClientProvider, layout, authentication UI, main view, and footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component shown to unauthenticated users with a prompt and button to sign in.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge displaying whether the user is signed in based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button handling Internet Identity login and logout with reactive UI states.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habit data with actor integration, optimistic updates, and auth checks.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main container that loads habits, handles auth/loading states, and displays the habit manager, month tabs, and habit grid.
Displays an error alert showing a failure message when habits fail to load.
Renders a skeleton placeholder layout for the habit grid while data is loading.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit, and monthly volume with validation and save mutations.
Displays the habit grid with day headers and habit rows or an empty state if no habits exist.
Defines layout constants and helpers for consistent habit grid column sizing.
Provides UI and logic for adding a new habit with inline input and mutation handling.
Renders a single habit row with info, monthly totals, day checkboxes, and edit controls.
Popover menu attached to a habit row providing edit actions.
Tab selector for switching between months using 2026 month metadata.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Provides 2026 month metadata and helper functions for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Builds habit completion maps, retrieves monthly volume entries, and formats completion and volume data for display.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Validates, parses, formats, and normalizes time strings in minutes or M:SS formats, providing related error messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, providing login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, color variables, and mobile interaction optimizations for the UI theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Extracts, stores, retrieves, and clears URL and session-based parameters with support for hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state describing a habit-tracking app with rules for monthly totals, habit types, and a revised editing UI plus pending feature requests.
